description: Land Acquisition - Kurukulawa, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed descriptions of the land lots, their extents, boundaries, and location. This falls squarely under the "Land Gazettes" category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition, which is a land and property-related matter.
